# pop project

Project management

## pop project create

Create a new project (direct tx; creator-hat/executor)

```text
pop project create [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bounty-caps` | string | no | - | Comma-separated bounty caps (wei) |
| `--bounty-tokens` | string | no | - | Comma-separated bounty token addresses |
| `--cap` | number | no | `0` | PT cap (0 = unlimited) |
| `--description` | string | no | - | Project description |
| `--managers` | string | no | - | Comma-separated project manager addresses |
| `--name` | string | yes | - | Project name |

## pop project propose

Propose a new project via governance vote

```text
pop project propose [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cap` | number | no | `0` | PT budget cap (0 = unlimited) |
| `--description` | string | no | - | Project description |
| `--duration` | number | no | `1440` | Vote duration in minutes (default 24h) |
| `--managers` | string | no | - | Comma-separated project manager addresses |
| `--name` | string | yes | - | Project name |

## pop project list

List projects

```text
pop project list [flags]
```

## pop project delete

Delete a project (destructive; creator-hat/executor)

```text
pop project delete [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | string | yes | - | Project ID (bytes32 or decimal) or name |

_Global flags: --org, --chain, --rpc, --json, --address, --private-key, --dry-run, --yes, --verbose, --quiet, --preflight (see [index.md](index.md))_
